text:
ana: FYI I merged Blink's finetune (LoRA r=8) into the reranker branch on staging ~08:20. Quick smoke shows NDCG dipped on the customer QA set.
priya: how big? is this rerank or recall?
tomas: ran quick-run: ndcg@10 baseline 0.732 -> merged 0.654 (-10.6%). recall@100 unchanged. looks like score ordering among top candidates shuffled.
kevin: any tokenization edits in the adapter? Blink sometimes ships a special token map.
ana: adapter manifest shows no tokenizer override, just the LoRA deltas. but the merge pipeline applied weight-fusion and then int4 packing.
ml-ci-bot: CI: rerank-smoke/blink (staging) 6a8  FAILED: ndcg regression > 8%. Report: https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/1187
priya: that suggests numeric packing or KL scaling issue not lexical changes. Tomas, can you run ablation: (1) fused+int4 (current), (2) nonfused+int4, (3) fused+int8, (4) fused+fp16?
tomas: kicking jobs now. using infra-gpu-staging-05 (ops-bot started job infra-2239).
ops-bot: Job infra-2239 started for tomas.
ml-ci-bot: Artifacts: blink_merged_int4 md5=a1b2c3d4, blink_merged_int8 md5=b2c3d4e5
tomas: first pass results: fused+int4 ndcg@10 0.652, nonfused+int4 0.729, fused+int8 0.725, fused+fp16 0.731. So fusion+int4 again the suspect.
nana: pattern matches other adapter cases. Could be that when we fold low-rank updates into weights before asymmetric 4-bit pack, residuals get clipped or bias-adjusted.
priya: do we do per-channel or per-tensor scale for the attention output proj? packing config: default=int4_asym_perblock (block size 128).
kevin: try per-row quant or switching to symmetric quant for the out-proj.
tomas: re-ran fused+int4 with per-row symmetric -> ndcg@10 0.728. passes.
nana: confirm: switching packing to per-row symmetric recovers rank-order.
priya: interesting: per-block asymmetric lowers dynamic range of small added LoRA signals. the larger components survive but subtle rerank deltas drop.
nana: dump example scores for one query id=Q102:
```
baseline scores: [2.31, 1.95, 1.62, 1.21]
merged_fused_int4 scores: [1.10, 1.05, 0.98, 0.92]
merged_nonfused_int4 scores: [2.29, 1.94, 1.60, 1.19]
```
priya: that looks like scale compression across the board for fused_int4. Are we accidentally re-normalizing logits after attention?
kevin: check softmax temperature/precision path. also check whether the adapter applies a tiny norm correction that we fold incorrectly.
tomas: inspected weight diffs: folded delta magnitude reduced by ~0.45x after packing with current pipeline.
nana: quick mitigation: revert staging to pre-merged-tag and disable fusion for adapters with rank <= 16 for int4 packing. ops?
ops-bot: Rolled back staging to tag rerank/blink-premerge @ 1739001100.
ml-ci-bot: Ticket created INF-3499: "int4 pack + LoRA fusion compresses rerank logits (Blink)" with attached traces.
priya: next steps: 1) implement heuristic in compile: if adapter_lo_ra_rank <= 16 and target_bits == 4 then force per-row symmetric pack OR skip fusion. 2) add a tiny rerank quick-eval in merge CI hitting ndcg@10 tolerance 5%. 3) add unit test merging a synthetic rank-8 LoRA and assert top-1 rank preservation > 0.98.
kevin: sounds good. please include perf delta table and CI job id when you push PR. prioritize a small revert-safe fix.
tomas: Will open PR with tests + CI patch. PR draft will reference INF-3499.
nana: can we add a small post-merge smoke harness that runs 50 sample queries from the customer's QA subset? catches these fast.
priya: yes - I'll add oak/blink-smoke.json to integration samples and wire it into the adapter-merge job.
kevin: appreciate the quick triage team. :+1:
nana: thanks all. closing once PR merged.
